order_note: Chapters are ordered by how many people each scam type hurts and how much they lose (FTC Consumer Sentinel 2024, FBI IC3 2024, Chainalysis 2025), after the Chapter 1 basics every later case builds on.

chapters.title: Fake Helpers
chapters.blurb: Fake banks, couriers, support and admins: the most reported scams.
chapters.learn: fake bank, courier, toll and refund messages, fake support and admins, and when a message is simply honest.

chapters.title: The Long Con
chapters.blurb: Fake investments and friendly strangers: the biggest money losses.
chapters.learn: "wrong number" friendships, guaranteed-profit trading apps, task-job scams and paid "recovery" agents.

chapters.title: Too Good To Be True
chapters.blurb: Free coins, prizes and presales that cost you everything.
chapters.learn: free airdrops and giveaways, fake presales, "send 1 get 2" streams and look-alike links.

chapters.title: Threats & Panic
chapters.blurb: Scams that scare you into paying.
chapters.learn: fake police and tax threats, "bank" calls, crypto ATM demands and fake virus pop-ups.

chapters.title: The Silent Drain
chapters.blurb: One click, one signature, an empty wallet.
chapters.learn: unlimited approvals, poisoned addresses, fake swap sites, blind signing and surprise NFTs.

chapters.title: Hijacked
chapters.blurb: When the scammer wears your friend's account, or your phone number.
chapters.learn: hacked friend accounts, fake wallet apps, SIM swaps, fake QR codes and "codes sent by mistake".

chapters.title: The Hype Machine
chapters.blurb: Pumps, rugs, fake influencers and deepfakes.
chapters.learn: pump-and-dump groups, honeypot tokens, fake influencers, deepfake videos and rug pulls.

chapters.title: Get-Rich Schemes
chapters.blurb: Pyramids, money machines and the final collapse.
chapters.learn: pyramid "invite friends" plans, fake staking and mining, trading bots and collapsing schemes.
